settings.content:
# Azure Update Manager Operations Dashboard
**Data range: last 30 days.** Latest maintenance run per configuration within this range. **Stalled:** in progress with no update for more than 10 minutes. **Long-running:** in progress for more than 90 minutes while data is fresh.

inputs.name: partTitle
inputs.value: Server progress by operating system and version

inputs.name: query
inputs.value: resources|where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines','microsoft.hybridcompute/machines')|extend ResourceId=tolower(id),OperatingSystem=case( type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines',coalesce(tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.sku),tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)),type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines',coalesce(tostring(properties.osSku),tostring(properties.osName),tostring(properties.osType)),'Unknown'),OsVersion=case( type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines',tostring(properties.storageProfile.imageReference.version),type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines',tostring(properties.osVersion),'Unknown')|project ResourceId,OperatingSystem=iff(isempty(OperatingSystem),'Unknown',OperatingSystem),OsVersion=iff(isempty(OsVersion),'Unknown',OsVersion)|join kind=inner ( maintenanceresources|where type =~ 'microsoft.maintenance/applyupdates'|extend ResourceId=tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)),StartUtc=todatetime(properties.startDateTime),RawStatus=tostring(properties.status)|where StartUtc >= ago(30d)|where isnotempty(ResourceId)|summarize arg_max(StartUtc,*) by ResourceId|extend OperationStatus=case( RawStatus in~ ('CompletedSuccess','NoUpdatesPending','UpdateSuccessfullyApplied','Succeeded','CompletedWithWarnings'),'Completed',RawStatus in~ ('Failed','Cancelled','ShutdownOrUnresponsive'),'Failed',RawStatus in~ ('InProgress','WaitingOnOngoingUpdate'),'InProgress','Other')|project ResourceId,OperationStatus ) on ResourceId|summarize TargetedServers=count(),CompletedServers=countif(OperationStatus =~ 'Completed'),FailedServers=countif(OperationStatus =~ 'Failed'),InProgressServers=countif(OperationStatus =~ 'InProgress') by OperatingSystem,OsVersion|order by FailedServers desc,InProgressServers desc,TargetedServers desc,OperatingSystem asc,OsVersion asc

inputs.name: partTitle
inputs.value: Completed, targeted, and failed servers by maintenance configuration

inputs.name: query
inputs.value: maintenanceresources|where type =~ 'microsoft.maintenance/applyupdates'|extend ResourceId=tolower(tostring(properties.resourceId)),ConfigurationId=tolower(tostring(properties.maintenanceConfigurationId)),CorrelationId=tolower(tostring(properties.correlationId)),StartUtc=todatetime(properties.startDateTime),EndUtc=todatetime(properties.endDateTime),SourceLastUpdatedUtc=todatetime(coalesce(properties.lastModifiedDateTime,properties.endDateTime,properties.startDateTime)),RawStatus=tostring(properties.status),RawError=tostring(properties.errorDetails)|where isnotempty(ResourceId) and isnotempty(ConfigurationId) and isnotempty(CorrelationId)|where StartUtc >= ago(30d)|join kind=inner ( maintenanceresources|where type =~ 'microsoft.maintenance/applyupdates'|extend ConfigurationId=tolower(tostring(properties.maintenanceConfigurationId)),LatestStartUtc=todatetime(properties.startDateTime)|where isnotempty(ConfigurationId)|where LatestStartUtc >= ago(30d)|summarize LatestStartUtc=max(LatestStartUtc) by ConfigurationId ) on ConfigurationId|where StartUtc == LatestStartUtc|summarize arg_max(SourceLastUpdatedUtc,*) by ResourceId,ConfigurationId|extend OperationStatus=case( RawStatus in~ ('CompletedSuccess','NoUpdatesPending','UpdateSuccessfullyApplied','Succeeded'),'Succeeded',RawStatus in~ ('CompletedWithWarnings'),'SucceededWithWarnings',RawStatus in~ ('InProgress','WaitingOnOngoingUpdate'),'InProgress',RawStatus in~ ('NotStarted'),'NotStarted',RawStatus in~ ('Failed','Cancelled','ShutdownOrUnresponsive'),'Failed','Unknown'),DataFreshness=case( isnull(SourceLastUpdatedUtc),'Unknown',datetime_diff('minute',now(),SourceLastUpdatedUtc) <= 10,'Fresh','Stale'),DurationMinutes=case( isnull(StartUtc),long(null),isnotnull(EndUtc),datetime_diff('minute',EndUtc,StartUtc),datetime_diff('minute',now(),StartUtc))|extend IsTerminal=OperationStatus in~ ('Succeeded','SucceededWithWarnings','Failed'),IsStalled=OperationStatus =~ 'InProgress' and DataFreshness =~ 'Stale',IsLongRunning=OperationStatus =~ 'InProgress' and DataFreshness =~ 'Fresh' and DurationMinutes > 90,MaintenanceConfiguration=tostring(split(ConfigurationId,'/')[8]),ServerName=tostring(split(ResourceId,'/')[8]),ResourceType=strcat(tostring(split(ResourceId,'/')[6]),'/',tostring(split(ResourceId,'/')[7]))|project ServerName,ResourceType,MaintenanceConfiguration,OperationStatus,DataFreshness,StartUtc,EndUtc,SourceLastUpdatedUtc,DurationMinutes,IsTerminal,IsStalled,IsLongRunning,ErrorInformation=RawError,CorrelationId,ResourceId,ConfigurationId|summarize Targeted=count(),Completed=countif(IsTerminal),Failed=countif(OperationStatus =~ 'Failed') by MaintenanceConfiguration|project MaintenanceConfiguration,CompletedServers=Completed,TargetedServers=Targeted,FailedServers=Failed|order by FailedServers desc,CompletedServers asc

inputs.name: query
inputs.value: patchassessmentresources|where type has 'patchassessmentresults'|where type !has 'softwarepatches'|extend Assessment=parse_json(properties)|extend ResourceId=tolower(tostring(split(tolower(id),'/patchassessmentresults/')[0])),AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc=todatetime(Assessment.lastModifiedDateTime),AssessmentStartUtc=todatetime(Assessment.startDateTime),AssessmentStatus=tostring(Assessment.status),OsType=tostring(Assessment.osType),RebootPending=tobool(Assessment.rebootPending),ErrorInformation=tostring(Assessment.errorDetails),CriticalUpdates=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.critical),0),SecurityUpdates=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.security),0),UpdateRollups=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.updateRollup),0),FeaturePacks=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.featurePack),0),ServicePacks=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.servicePack),0),DefinitionUpdates=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.definition),0),Updates=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.updates),0),Tools=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.tools),0),OtherUpdates=coalesce(toint(Assessment.availablePatchCountByClassification.other),0)|where AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc >= ago(30d)|where isnotempty(ResourceId)|summarize arg_max(AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc,*) by ResourceId|extend TotalPendingUpdates=CriticalUpdates + SecurityUpdates + UpdateRollups + FeaturePacks + ServicePacks + DefinitionUpdates + Updates + Tools + OtherUpdates,ServerName=tostring(split(ResourceId,'/')[8])|extend ComplianceStatus=case( AssessmentStatus in~ ('Failed','Error'),'AssessmentFailed',AssessmentStatus =~ 'InProgress','AssessmentInProgress',TotalPendingUpdates == 0,'Compliant','UpdatesPending')|project ServerName,OsType,ComplianceStatus,AssessmentStatus,TotalPendingUpdates,CriticalUpdates,SecurityUpdates,RebootPending,AssessmentStartUtc,AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc,ErrorInformation,ResourceId|summarize AssessedServers=count(),CompliantServers=countif(ComplianceStatus =~ 'Compliant'),ServersWithPendingUpdates=countif(ComplianceStatus =~ 'UpdatesPending'),AssessmentFailures=countif(ComplianceStatus =~ 'AssessmentFailed'),AssessmentsInProgress=countif(ComplianceStatus =~ 'AssessmentInProgress'),RebootPendingServers=countif(RebootPending),CriticalUpdatesAvailable=sum(CriticalUpdates),SecurityUpdatesAvailable=sum(SecurityUpdates),TotalUpdatesAvailable=sum(TotalPendingUpdates),LatestAssessmentUtc=max(AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc)

inputs.name: query
inputs.value: patchassessmentresources|where type has 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'|extend Patch=parse_json(properties)|extend ResourceId=tolower(tostring(split(tolower(id),'/patchassessmentresults/')[0])),AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc=todatetime(Patch.lastModifiedDateTime),UpdateName=tostring(Patch.patchName),KbId=tostring(Patch.kbId),Classification=strcat_array(Patch.classifications,','),Version=tostring(Patch.version),InstallationState=tostring(Patch.installationState)|where AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc >= ago(30d)|where isnotempty(ResourceId) and isnotempty(UpdateName)|where InstallationState !in~ ('Installed','Succeeded')|extend KbId=iff(isempty(KbId),'N/A',KbId),Classification=iff(isempty(Classification),'Unclassified',Classification),Version=iff(isempty(Version),'N/A',Version)|summarize ServersMissingUpdate=dcount(ResourceId),LatestAssessmentUtc=max(AssessmentLastUpdatedUtc) by UpdateName,KbId,Classification,Version|project UpdateName,KbId,Classification,Version,ServersMissingUpdate,LatestAssessmentUtc|order by ServersMissingUpdate desc,UpdateName asc
